purpose: Head of a 5-entry array of heap pointers holding the per-stage screen-save buffers for the layered dialog-frame open animation; the array head doubles as the restore handle returned to the caller.
logic_summary: Pure runtime state, all-zero at load (BSS). fd2_play_dialog_open_animation populates all 5 slots in a malloc loop (each slot = malloc(0x682C) = 27692 bytes; asm MOV [ESI*4 + 0x53A18], EAX, stride 4, ESI 0..4), then reads each slot back as the 32-bit dst-buffer arg to fd2_save_screen_block_to_buffer across the 5 frame-assembly stages (slots 0x53A18 / 0x53A1C / 0x53A20 / 0x53A24 / 0x53A28). The function returns the array head (MOV EAX,0x53A18); fd2_close_dialog_panels_then_slide_in_at later uses it to free the buffers and restore the screen on dialog close.
element_semantics: Each element [i] (i=0..4) is one heap pointer (malloc(0x682C)) used as the destination save buffer snapshotting the screen band covered by frame-assembly stage i+1; freed in reverse order on dialog close.
